## What This Experiment Tests

Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `img_intensity2` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Tests photometric amplitude fidelity rather than spatial position: a centered 4x4 square must be generated at both target brightnesses (0.35 and 0.85) with tight template RMSE (<= 0.06).

> [!NOTE]
> **Protocol notes:** Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `img_intensity2` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.

## Laws & Edge Cases Targeted

- **[Law 1: Representational Geometry](../LAWS_HUB.md#law1)** ([Law 1 theory](../../../docs/four-laws.md#law-1--representational-geometry)) — Can the system represent the required probability measure efficiently and faithfully?
- **[Law 2: Potential Geometry](../LAWS_HUB.md#law2)** ([Law 2 theory](../../../docs/four-laws.md#law-2--potential-geometry)) — Does the critic communicate useful learning forces with appropriate geometric control and computational efficiency?
- **[Law 3A: Unconditional W1 Ray-Length & Feature-Space Screening Identifiability](../LAWS_HUB.md#law3a)** ([Law 3A theory](../../../docs/four-laws.md#law-3--transport-identifiability)) — Does the learning system possess enough information to determine appropriate transport?
- **Edge-case tags:** `discrete-images-8x8`, `photometric-intensity`, `tight-rmse`, `legacy-prior-cohort`

## Common Failure Mode

Trainers collapse to a single intermediate gray level (~0.60) or drop the dimmer/brighter mode entirely.
